meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想找现成的技能(比如处理文档、优化代码的小工具)时,Claude 会去开放的技能商店里搜索,核对安装量和来源后推荐给你,并可以帮你安装。
howto.when: 当用户问“怎么做 X”、“找 X 的技能”等,或表示想扩展能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找个生成 changelog 的技能。
say.note: 搜索 changelog 相关技能

say.text: 有没有提高 React 性能的现成技能?
say.note: 会搜索 react performance 并推荐

say.text: 搜一下 PR 审核的技能,装一个。
say.note: 查 leaderboard 并尝试安装

howto.what_en: Once installed, when the user wants to find an existing skill (e.g. for document processing or code optimization), Claude searches the open skills ecosystem, checks install counts and sources, recommends options, and can install them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", etc., or expresses interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Find me a skill for generating a changelog.
Is there an existing skill for React performance?
Search for a PR review skill and install it.
say_en.note: Checks leaderboard and tries to install
